clauses.quote: The $1,500 bonus shall be paid within sixty (60) Calendar Days following completion of the second certification.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; management is the implicit obligor.

clauses.quote: The Teacher shall be required to work in DCPS for a minimum of three (3) years after receiving the bonus unless terminated by DCPS.
In the event that the Teacher fails to meet the three-year commitment, s/he shall be obligated to return the compensation to DCPS on a prorated basis.
clauses.notes: Repayment obligation triggered by failure to meet commitment.
